facts.fact: We are Tech reports Burkina Faso has established the Permanent Secretariat for Innovation and Monitoring of Emerging Digital Technologies (SPIVTEN), tasked with overseeing and regulating AI development, as Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane told the Transitional Legislative Assembly.
We are Tech reports the DJAM platform and regulatory chatbots have been launched in Burkina Faso to streamline digital access and automate administrative processes, per Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane.
